content.comment_body: I am setting up a program and would like to use the F1 / F2 function keys on the [product_name] HMI panel to change the setpoint value of a parts counter. Is this possible? Currently, I can use the keys only to modify a counter that serves as a setpoint for a time counter, but not the counter directly. On the HMI configuration screen, I've tried to set up the counter to increment via the function keys, but none of my attempts worked. What I've managed is to display the counter, use the ESC key, wait 2 seconds, then select the counter area and slowly adjust the preset value, confirming with ENTER. I'm hoping for a faster way using only the function keys. Is this possible, and if so, how? If available, could you provide an example? Thank you.

Thanks for your input. I liked the program and plan to use part of it for another project. However, my aim is to adjust the setpoint of the counter using F1 / F2, similar to counting parts on digital input 1. Is this possible—setting the value with F1 / F2, and triggering the counter by a digital input?
I'm attaching an example that should help you get started. When combined with the previous program, this should achieve your goal.

Yes! This is exactly what I needed. I do have another question: To download it to [product_name], I had to insert an analog output block in B005, otherwise the process failed. My device doesn't have analog outputs, only digital ones. Was this a problem? Please see the attached file.
Apologies for the oversight. I should have included an analog flag. Please see the attached correction.
All good. This is exactly the solution I needed. Thank you very much for your help and thanks to the other contributors as well.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wanted to quickly adjust a counter setpoint via function keys on the [product_name] HMI, as the default configuration was slow and complicated. Community members responded with example programs and suggestions, ultimately resulting in an effective solution. Along the way, a minor issue related to an unnecessary analog output block was identified and resolved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to use F1/F2 function keys to quickly and directly adjust the setpoint of a counter on the HMI, simplifying operation.
